class.name: RosSubscriber
class.brief_description: A ROS 2 Subscriber for receiving messages from a topic.
class.description: [RosSubscriber] allows Godot to listen for [RosMsg] data from other ROS 2 nodes. It is created through [method RosNode.create_subscriber]. When a new message is received on the topic, the callback provided during creation is triggered, passing a [RosMsg] instance as its only argument. The subscription remains active as long as this object is not freed.
